description: This file is a PHP class that manages CAPTCHA extensions within the admin panel of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It provides methods for listing available CAPTCHA extensions, installing new ones, and uninstalling existing ones, with dynamic loading of related controllers, models, and views.

classes.name: Captcha
classes.description: Controller class for managing CAPTCHA extensions in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing, installing, and uninstalling CAPTCHA modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets the output for the default index route by displaying the list of CAPTCHA extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the list of available CAPTCHA extensions, indicating which are installed.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a selected CAPTCHA extension, including permission checks, registering controllers and models, and invoking extension-specific install routines.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a CAPTCHA extension, including permission checks and invoking extension-specific uninstall routines.
